name: agastya-platform-v2
description: Offline, on-premises S1000D authoring and publishing platform: workspace, projects, the S1000D Studio editor, validation, release and PDF publishing.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:verify: npm --prefix frontend run test:verify && npm --prefix backend run test:verify
scripts.verify: npm run test:verify && npm run test:verify:elements && npm run test:verify:e2e && npm run verify:report
